notes:
Account overview: Pelagia is a national maritime intelligence agency building a consolidated RAG search across ship logs, AIS feeds, classified incident reports, and analyst notes. Primary constraint = must operate in air-gapped datacenters (no egress). Procurement-heavy; long procurement lead time (estimated Q1 FY25 close).

Key technical requirements (from SE calls):
- Indexing scale: target ~120M documents, 3-5B tokens; incremental ingestion at ~200k docs/day from port systems.
- Embedding strategy: high-dimensional embeddings preferred for precision; want on-prem vector store with multi-shard nearest neighbor and deterministic reranking step.
- Reranking: neural reranker after ANN recall step to improve precision on low-recall queries (high consequence). Need configurable re-rank budget per query.
- Latency/throughput: 95th p90 < 250ms for short fact lookups; batched analytics queries allowed higher latency. Expected steady-state QPS for live search ~80 qps, spike to 600 qps during incident surges.
- Cost sensitivity: tight OPEX constraints for cloud; prefer predictable reserved pricing or fixed-capacity model.

Security/compliance notes:
- CISO requires SSO/SAML integration for analysts, KMS/HSM for key management, full audit logs for query and model access, and offline-installable artifacts with SBOM.
- Data residency: all data must remain inside org network; optional replication to DR facility in same gov cloud region.
- They asked for a transcript-proof POC that can run without outbound network (we proposed a USB-distro style installer plus signed container images).

Commercial/procurement notes:
- They will evaluate Redwood Private (on-prem) with Dedicated capacity for the inference tier and Optimize for tuning cost/performance.
- PV: Interested in an annual committed capacity contract; RA will prepare draft SOW and IL4 packaging. Finance wants clear unit economics: cost per query for 1M queries/month with 120M-index baseline.
- Comp concerns: "We like Palantir for end-to-end but expensive; Elastic is familiar but lacks secure NN reranker as a managed offering."

POC plan agreed (high-level):
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): Security & packaging review, finalize SBOM and installer checklist.
- Phase 2 (3 weeks on-prem POC): Import 5M representative docs, measure embed throughput, ANN recall latency, and reranker accuracy on Redwood models.
- Phase 3 (1 month): Scale tests to 50M docs, report cost/Q, propose production topology and reserved capacity commit.

Quotes & direct items from meetings:
- CISO: "No external egress; we need a box we can ship to the datacenter and install behind the firewall."
- Head of Search: "Precision at the top is everything — false positives in incident triage cost lives."

- Priya Menon (SE): produce on-prem POC checklist and resource estimate (due 2024-12-06).
